grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: My Daily Routine
instructions: 阅读短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟练习，非官方考试。
passage:
A
My name is Li Hua. I am a student. I get up at 6:30 every morning. I have breakfast at 7:00. I go to school at 7:30. I have four classes in the morning. I have lunch at 12:00. In the afternoon, I have two classes. I go home at 4:30. I do my homework in the evening. I go to bed at 10:00.

B
My friend is Wang Ming. He is a student too. He gets up at 7:00. He has breakfast at 7:30. He goes to school at 8:00. He has three classes in the morning. He has lunch at 12:30. In the afternoon, he has two classes. He goes home at 5:00. He plays football after school. He does his homework in the evening. He goes to bed at 10:30.

C
We are students. We go to school from Monday to Friday. We have classes every day. We like our school. We are good friends.

questions.explanation: 原文说：I go home at 4:30. 所以填4:30。

questions.prompt: 王明放学后做什么运动？请用原文中的一个词回答。

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形。例如：I get up at 6:30. You go to school. We like our school. They play football.
grammar.example: I get up at 6:30 every morning.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的动词形式：I ____ to school every day.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 go。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的动词形式：We ____ English.
questions.explanation: 主语是 We，动词用原形 like。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的动词形式：They ____ football after school.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，动词用原形 play。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的动词形式：You ____ breakfast at 7:00.
questions.explanation: 主语是 You，动词用原形 have。
